items.html: And we shall return to the first matter, that at the time of Chatzot, Leah returns face to face to couple with Yaakov, and her stature is in the entire length of ZA; however, Rachel at that time finishes her matter of diminution, until she remains in the secret of a single point; and the feet of Leah pushed her, and she was forced to enter and descend below, into the world of Beria.
